patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Pretendard, Wanted Sans.
<Alert> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tone, title, icon, action, children.
<Alert> tone must be one of 'info' | 'positive' | 'negative' | 'cautionary'.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, alt, name, type, size.
<Avatar> type must be one of 'person' | 'company'.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: type, count, max, color, dot, children.
<Badge> type must be one of 'value' | 'dot'.
<Badge> color must be one of 'negative' | 'primary' | 'positive'.

<Button> variant must be one of 'solid' | 'outlined' | 'text'.
<Button> color must be one of 'primary' | 'neutral'.
<Button> size must be one of 'large' | 'medium' | 'small' | 'xsmall'.
